# T-1: Define artifact completion

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create the shared producer-side completion contract and dedicated result classes for success and unresolved mechanical failure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The helper runs normalize, validate, one deterministic repair attempt when configured, and revalidate in that order.
- The helper returns dedicated classes and has no direct flow transition or retry side effects.
- Unit tests cover pass, fail, repairable, and unrepairable paths.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the helper small and caller-neutral. Prefer placing it near existing artifact validation utilities unless source inspection shows a better local module.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests with fake validators and repair functions.
